audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Spirit Needle (E) roots' — Aurora's E is The Weirding, a damaging SLOW with a backward hop; nothing in her kit roots. Her W is repeatedly called 'Blink (W)' — Across the Veil is a leap into stealth, not a blink. Her passive heals her (anti-heal case) but spikes[0] calls it 'chip damage'. No digits in breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.why: Riot kit text is the authority on names and effects.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..2], mid, late, whys[1], early, wants entries rewritten with real names/effects; anti-heal folded into dosFull[1].d; cooldown numbers added (W 22-18s, E 15s r1).

edits.before: Aurora leans on Twofold Hex (Q) poke and Spirit Needle (E) roots, but her early trading up close is weak.
